resources.string: A device on your network (%1$s) asks you to sign in to %2$s at %3$s. It will get access to the account you sign in to. Continue only if you just scanned the code on your own device.
Can\'t reach the other device. Both have to be on the same network: connect it to this phone\'s hotspot, say, and scan its code again.
This code is no longer valid. Show a new one on the other device and scan it.
Sent. The other device finishes signing in.
Couldn\'t send the sign-in to the other device.
Signs the other device in to %1$s. CloudMus has to be installed on this phone.
